column7: UpdateUser persisted its pre-read user row via UpdateUserIfActiveStateMatches's Select("*") full-row write gated only on is_active, so an admin profile edit racing a SuspendUser on another replica wrote account_state='active' back (suspension reported success, silently reverted). Fixed by column-scoping the write to the profile columns UpdateUser owns. Found by C-GUARD2-EXEMPT-REVIEW (#2662)
